name: Tsuga Yuuji
source:
"Hey, stop it. I'm supposed to be these guys' big brother."

The oldest member of the SRX team, and only one with actual life experience.
He's enjoying this new chance at a 'student' life.
An optimistic and kind person, but he's scary when he snaps.
A reliable person who acts like an older brother to the all the younger members of the team, he's always looking after them.
He's actually the oldest sibling of a large family and really thinks of the other members like younger brothers.
His hobby is fishing.
He plays bass for the Odd-I's band.
His partner Substance is [url=/c30012]Deviser[/url].
